01 / SKATESteer with arrows or A / D. You roll automatically. Phone: hold the road to boost; swipe left/right to steer and up to jump while holding. Lift your finger to slow down. Hold ↑, W, Shift or Boost to go faster.
02 / GET PAIDJump does random tricks. Ride ramps for big-air payouts. Line up with rails to grind automatically; stay in their lane to finish. Press E / Throw within 160 m to toss across lanes, or deliver from its curb lane. Deliveries add 2 seconds. Time your jump to clear cars; grounded collisions end your shift; barrel wipeouts cost 3 seconds.
03 / STAY EMPLOYEDEarn +$25 Hazard Pay on your first delivery each dog chase. Get caught? Ambulance. Fired. Carry up to 3 toys. Toys are scarce: center your lane and stay on the ground to collect the pink bones, or buy them in the skate shop. Q tosses left, R tosses right. Bitey is distracted for 3 seconds; 12-second cooldown.

Close car dodges earn $4. Time a delivery near its marker for an $8 tip. Link different tricks and grinds within 3 seconds, then deliver to bank a combo bonus. At forks, choose Scenic for less traffic or Shortcut for +50% delivery pay. Dodge barrels and parcel carriers; jump sprinkler sprays. Explore Downtown → Suburbs → Boardwalk.

Every 3 consecutive deliveries earns $12. Miss one and the streak resets. Pizza earns a hot-delivery tip. Glass trophies lose value in crashes. Birthday cakes need slow, straight landings. Live lobsters try to escape: press F or tap Secure lobster when warned. Soup and cake lose value after wipeouts. Clear an obstacle, then deliver within 3 seconds for a $12 Special Delivery bonus. Bitey can steal your package—boost after him to get it back!
